name: dealer-equity-mining-campaign-builder
description: Build a complete equity mining campaign for a car dealership: blueprint (cadence, channels, gates, KPIs) plus messaging templates (SMS, email, ringless voicemail) across the proven 3-channel cadence. Six standard personas: lease returner, equity-positive trade-up, service-to-sales, OEM-program eligible, upside-down upgrader, dormant reactivation. Compliance guardrails (opt-in gates, suppression, frequency caps, TCPA) baked into every touch.
